items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Although, I guess that in the late 60s when Norman Keenan and Harold Jones were with Basie, apparently when Basie did some of those commercial, you know like Beatles albums and things like that Norman Keenan would double electric bass on certain things.
